name: agentsfleet
description: Fleet Delivery Control Plane — long-lived, event-driven autonomous workers (Fleets) scoped to a workspace.

operations.description: Provision a new Fleet in the given workspace. Returns the fleet_id used for subsequent operations.

Partial update of a Fleet. Body fields are optional and presence-based: name (rename the instance) and/or status ("active" to resume, "stopped" to halt, "killed" to mark terminal). Setup changes go through apply_fleet_revision. The 'paused' state is platform-only — anomaly-gate auto-halt — and rejected here.

Hard-delete a Fleet and cascade its history (events, telemetry, sessions, approval gates, memory entries). Precondition: status='killed' — kill the fleet before deleting. Returns 204 on success, 409 if not yet killed.
Post a chat message to a running Fleet's loop.
List the Fleet's event history with pagination.
Server-Sent Events stream of new events as they arrive.
Read the caller tenant's credit-pool balance and exhaustion state.
List newest-first credit-pool charge telemetry rows for the caller tenant.

One bounded keyset page of the model catalogue, newest-updated date in `version`. Supports `limit`, `starting_after`, a `q` substring over model id and provider, and an exact `provider` filter. Carries an ETag; a matching If-None-Match answers 304. Follow `next_cursor` — the first page is not the whole catalogue.
One bounded keyset page of the caller tenant's own model registry. Follow `next_cursor` to read all of it.

One bounded keyset page of the workspace Fleet library gallery — the union of the platform catalog and this workspace's own entries, and nothing from another workspace. Support-file manifests are not served on the workspace plane.

Deliver an inbound event to the Fleet's webhook trigger whose source the URL names; this is the URL Save returns for each webhook trigger. The body must be Hash-Based Message Authentication Code with Secure Hash Algorithm 256 (HMAC-SHA256) signed with the workspace credential matching that trigger's source (e.g. vault row fleet:github, field webhook_secret); the provider-specific signature header is verified before the body is read. Idempotent within 24h via event_id.
Read complete-period settled totals, spending groups and a bounded activity page for the caller tenant.
Read a bounded page of settled charges for one activity within the caller tenant and selected filters.
Load private working notes for one run branch under the current runner assignment.
Conditionally replace private working notes under the current assignment and expected generation. Identical retries acknowledge one write.

revenue.description: Users may supply their own Large Language Model (LLM) API keys. agentsfleet meters hosted execution against a credit pool: event receipts are free, active runtime is $0.0001/sec under both postures, and platform-managed posture also adds provider token costs. New tenants receive a $5 starter credit. Usage lines retain recorded token counts, model price references and combined runtime/token charges.
